title: Lincoln Villa | 7 Bedroom 5.5 Bath 12+ Beds
description: BRAND NEW FULLY RENOVATED 2025, The Lincoln Villa is a beautifully designed vacation home in the heart of Scottsdale. With 7 bedrooms, 5.5 bathrooms, and space to sleep 16 guests, it's perfect for group getaways or family vacations. The home is just 15 minutes from the airport and 10 minutes from popular attractions like Barrett-Jackson, the Waste Management Open, multiple spring training stadiums and 5 minutes from Old Town Scottsdale
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Perfect for big groups where everyone had their own space and didn't feel cramped. The outside was great with the pool and a place to sit and eat in the shade if needed! Also just a short drive to downtown Scottsdale which was exactly what my group and I were looking for.
This home was BEAUTIFUL! Very clean, enough space for everyone and the owner was sooo responsive to any needs we had. I loved it here.
Nice place! Looks better in person. Pool was a good size and we very much so enjoyed our time.
Amazing home. So well thought out in layout, amenities and decor. Would book again!
Great place, great pool, lots of space, very clean, perfect for what our group needed!
